name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-yango-retail
title: Yango Tech Retail MCP
description: MCP server for the Yango Tech Retail B2B API: orders, products, prices, discounts, stocks.

environmentVariables.name: YANGO_RETAIL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token issued by Yango Tech for the retailer account. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANGO_RETAIL_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for reads only).
